description: Search and list Zotero/Firefox preferences. Use to discover available preference keys before using zotero_get_pref/zotero_set_pref. Can filter by branch prefix (e.g., 'extensions.zotero.') and/or substring pattern.

branch.description: Preference branch to list (e.g., 'extensions.zotero.', 'general.'). Defaults to 'extensions.zotero.' if not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

name: zotero_search_prefs
